en: An aerial view from a high, rocky mountainside looking down over a cable car suspended on multiple cables. The white, cylindrical cable car cabin marked with the number '2' descends toward a broad valley with a river, patchwork farm fields, roads, and small settlements. The scene evokes an Alpine landscape with steep limestone cliffs and cultivated lowlands below.
